editorial:
Imagine being so broke that you have to find old scraps in a junkyard just to pay for your kid's school. That is the world you enter with a hardworking dad and his sweet son. Everything changes when the dad finds a weird green ball that turns out to be a cute alien named CJ7. The movie feels like a warm hug, blending silly humor with some really sad moments that will make you reach for the tissues. You get to see a beautiful bond between a father and son who have nothing but each other, and the alien just adds a layer of magic to their struggle.

What really works here is the heart. While the special effects look a bit dated now, the acting is sincere and the pacing keeps you interested. You might find some of the comedy a bit over-the-top, but it fits the whimsical vibe perfectly. If you want a movie that makes you smile and cry at the same time, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection, but streaming it in high definition on your favorite platform is also a solid way to enjoy the colors.
endingExplained: After CJ7 helps the boy get into a better school and saves him from bullies, the alien eventually has to leave Earth to return to its own planet. It is a tear-jerker moment because the boy loves his friend so much. Years later, you see the boy grown up as a successful man. He remembers the lessons of kindness and love he learned from his dad and his alien friend, showing that the magic of CJ7 stayed with him forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family stories and cute creatures.
